LPT:0000001.name: livestock product trait
LPT:0000001.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of a product produced by or obtained from the body of an agricultural animal or bird maintained for use and profit.

LPT:0000002.name: milk alpha-casein content
LPT:0000002.def: The proportion or amount in milk of the alpha fraction of the casein phosphoprotein.

LPT:0000003.name: egg yolk color
LPT:0000003.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the visually perceived hue of the nutrient store of the egg that is surround by a vitelline membrane.

LPT:0000004.name: drumstick bone weight
LPT:0000004.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue in the lower hindlimb of a bird, consisting of the tibia and the surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000005.name: shoulder external fat weight
LPT:0000005.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose trimmed from the outside of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000006.name: dressed carcass width
LPT:0000006.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance from side to side of the body of an animal following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000007.name: meat fatty acid C20:0 content
LPT:0000007.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C20H40O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000008.name: meat fatty acid cis-5,8,11,14-C20:4 content
LPT:0000008.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an omega-6 unsaturated fatty acid (C20H32O2), with four carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000009.name: milk fatty acid C15:0 content
LPT:0000009.def: The proportion or amount in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a fifteen-carbon backbone.

LPT:0000010.name: milk fatty acid C24:0 content
LPT:0000010.def: The proportion or amount in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a twenty-four-carbon backbone.

LPT:0000011.name: milk fatty acid C12:1(n-3) content
LPT:0000011.def: The proportion or amount in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with a twelve-carbon backbone and one double bond.

LPT:0000012.name: meat monounsaturated fatty acid content
LPT:0000012.def: The proportion or amount of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in meat; the carbon chain has only one double or triple carbon-carbon bond.

LPT:0000013.name: meat fatty acid cis-9-C14:1 content
LPT:0000013.def: The proportion or amount of an omega-5, monounsaturated fatty acid (C14H26O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000014.name: meat fatty acid C20:5(n-3) content
LPT:0000014.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an omega-3, unsaturated fatty acid (C20H30O2), with five carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.
synonyms: meat fatty acid C20:5 n-3 content

LPT:0000015.name: loin weight
LPT:0000015.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000016.name: meat fatty acid C22:4 content
LPT:0000016.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an unsaturated fatty acid (C22H36O2), with four carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000017.name: meat fatty acid C22:5 content
LPT:0000017.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an unsaturated fatty acid (C22H34O2), with five carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000018.name: meat fatty acid C22:6 content
LPT:0000018.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an unsaturated fatty acid (C22H32O2), with six carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000019.name: meat fatty acid C20:3 content
LPT:0000019.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an unsaturated fatty acid (C20H34O2), with three carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000020.name: meat polyunsaturated fatty acid content
LPT:0000020.def: The proportion or amount of organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons present in meat; the carbon chain has two or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds.

LPT:0000021.name: dressed carcass muscle weight
LPT:0000021.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the movement-producing contractile tissue of an animal, following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000022.name: dressed carcass bone weight
LPT:0000022.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue of an animal following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000023.name: loin external fat weight
LPT:0000023.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the fat trimmed from the surface of the loin.

LPT:0000024.name: loin muscle weight
LPT:0000024.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the muscles in the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000025.name: shoulder fat weight
LPT:0000025.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000026.name: egg organoleptic trait
LPT:0000026.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to qualities of the egg (an ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings) that involve perception by the senses.

LPT:0000027.name: dressed carcass fat weight
LPT:0000027.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue of an animal following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000028.name: loin fat weight
LPT:0000028.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000029.name: shoulder bone weight
LPT:0000029.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue in the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000030.name: meat water content
LPT:0000030.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of moisture in meat.

LPT:0000031.name: milk fatty acid cis-10-C17:1 content
LPT:0000031.def: The proportion or amount in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-10.

LPT:0000032.name: milk fatty acid cis-11-C18:1 content
LPT:0000032.def: The proportion or amount in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-11.

LPT:0000033.name: thigh bone weight
LPT:0000033.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue in the part of a bird consisting of the femur and surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000034.name: meat fatty acid cis-11-C18:1 content
LPT:0000034.def: The proportion or amount in meat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-11.

LPT:0000035.name: meat fatty acid cis-10-C17:1 content
LPT:0000035.def: The proportion or amount in meat of a monounsaturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-10.

LPT:0000036.name: meat omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid content
LPT:0000036.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount in meat of polyunsaturated fatty acids in which the first unsaturated bond is in the third position from the omega carbon.

LPT:0000037.name: meat fatty acid C15:0 content
LPT:0000037.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C15H30O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000038.name: meat conjugated linoleic acid content
LPT:0000038.def: The proportion or amount in meat of any/all isomers of linoleic acid in which the double bonds are conjugated (double bonds alternate with single bonds); found especially in meat and dairy products derived from ruminants.

LPT:0000039.name: ham fat weight
LPT:0000039.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the hind leg of the pig.

LPT:0000040.name: loin size trait
LPT:0000040.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000041.name: rib cut weight
LPT:0000041.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut of beef spanning the sixth through twelfth ribs.

LPT:0000042.name: ham size trait
LPT:0000042.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the cut from the hind leg of the pig.

LPT:0000043.name: ham fat thickness
LPT:0000043.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance between the surfaces of the external layer of fat on the ham.

LPT:0000044.name: egg odor intensity
LPT:0000044.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the perceived intensity of the smell of an egg.

LPT:0000045.name: egg shell stiffness
LPT:0000045.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of elasticity or flexibility of the outermost protective covering of the egg.

LPT:0000046.name: meat estrone content
LPT:0000046.def: The proportion or amount of this estrogenic hormone, C18H22O2, in muscle or its associated fat.

LPT:0000047.name: meat glucose-6-phosphate content
LPT:0000047.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount in meat of an ester of glucose with phosphate attached to carbon atom 6.

LPT:0000048.name: dressed carcass size trait
LPT:0000048.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000049.name: dressed carcass composition trait
LPT:0000049.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000050.name: dressed carcass bone content
LPT:0000050.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of skeletal tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000051.name: dressed carcass fat content
LPT:0000051.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of adipose tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000052.name: dressed carcass bone percentage
LPT:0000052.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000053.name: dressed carcass muscle content
LPT:0000053.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of muscle tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000054.name: dressed carcass fat percentage
LPT:0000054.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000055.name: dressed carcass muscle percentage
LPT:0000055.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to relative heaviness of the muscle tissue in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000056.name: dressed carcass subdivision trait
LPT:0000056.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to an anatomical structure which is a subpart of the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000057.name: rib cut thickness
LPT:0000057.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance between the surfaces of the muscle layer in the cut of beef spanning the sixth through twelfth ribs.

LPT:0000058.name: drumstick trait
LPT:0000058.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the lower hindlimb of a bird, consisting of the tibia and the surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000059.name: rib cut trait
LPT:0000059.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut of beef spanning the sixth through twelfth ribs.

LPT:0000060.name: drumstick percentage
LPT:0000060.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the lower hindlimb of a bird, consisting of the tibia and the surrounding muscle and skin, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000061.name: belly trait
LPT:0000061.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:0000062.name: shoulder trait
LPT:0000062.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000063.name: ham trait
LPT:0000063.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut from the hind leg of the pig.

LPT:0000064.name: ham composition trait
LPT:0000064.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the cut from the hind leg of the pig.

LPT:0000065.name: loin trait
LPT:0000065.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000066.name: loin percentage
LPT:0000066.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the back of certain species, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000067.name: loin composition trait
LPT:0000067.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000068.name: belly size trait
LPT:0000068.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:0000069.name: belly composition trait
LPT:0000069.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:0000070.name: ham percentage
LPT:0000070.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the hind leg of the pig, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000071.name: shoulder size trait
LPT:0000071.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000072.name: shoulder composition trait
LPT:0000072.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:0000073.name: shoulder percentage
LPT:0000073.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000074.name: drumstick size trait
LPT:0000074.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the lower hindlimb of a bird, consisting of the tibia and the surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000075.name: drumstick composition trait
LPT:0000075.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the lower hindlimb of a bird, consisting of the tibia and the surrounding meat and skin.

LPT:0000076.name: ham fat percentage
LPT:0000076.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the hind leg of the pig, expressed as a percentage of ham weight.

LPT:0000077.name: belly percentage
LPT:0000077.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut obtained from the underside of the pig, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000078.name: belly muscle percentage
LPT:0000078.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the muscle tissue in the cut obtained from the underside of the pig, expressed as a percentage of belly weight.

LPT:0000079.name: shoulder bone percentage
LPT:0000079.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the skeletal tissue in the cut from the upper portion of the front leg, expressed as a percentage of shoulder weight.

LPT:0000080.name: shoulder fat percentage
LPT:0000080.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the upper portion of the front leg, expressed as a percentage of shoulder weight.

LPT:0000081.name: shoulder muscle percentage
LPT:0000081.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg, with fat and bone removed, expressed as a percentage of shoulder weight.

LPT:0000082.name: thigh trait (poultry)
LPT:0000082.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the part of a bird consisting of the femur and surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000083.name: thigh muscle percentage
LPT:0000083.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the muscle tissue surrounding the femur of a bird, expressed as a percentage of thigh weight or carcass/body weight.

LPT:0000084.name: thigh composition trait (poultry)
LPT:0000084.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the part of a bird consisting of the femur and surrounding muscle and skin.

LPT:0000085.name: leg trait
LPT:0000085.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000086.name: leg weight
LPT:0000086.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000087.name: leg percentage
LPT:0000087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s), expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000088.name: leg muscle weight
LPT:0000088.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of muscle tissue in the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000089.name: leg size trait
LPT:0000089.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000090.name: breast trait (poultry)
LPT:0000090.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the cut containing the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor.

LPT:0000091.name: total breast muscle weight
LPT:0000091.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the combined pectoralis major and pectoralis minor.

LPT:0000092.name: total breast muscle percentage
LPT:0000092.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the combined pectoralis major and pectoralis minor, expressed as a percentage of carcass/body weight.

LPT:0000093.name: pectoralis major weight
LPT:0000093.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the larger muscle of the breast.

LPT:0000094.name: pectoralis minor weight
LPT:0000094.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the smaller muscle of the breast.

LPT:0000095.name: pectoralis major percentage
LPT:0000095.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the larger muscle of the breast, expressed as a percentage of carcass/body weight.

LPT:0000096.name: pectoralis minor percentage
LPT:0000096.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the smaller muscle of the breast, expressed as a percentage of carcass/body weight.

LPT:0000097.name: leg composition trait
LPT:0000097.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000098.name: intramuscular fat content
LPT:0000098.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of fat-storing cells/tissue present within skeletal muscle.

LPT:0000099.name: intermuscular fat content
LPT:0000099.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of fat-storing tissue present between the muscles.

LPT:0000100.name: meat fatty acid C10:0 content
LPT:0000100.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C10H20O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000101.name: meat fatty acid cis-10-C15:1 content
LPT:0000101.def: The proportion or amount in meat of a monounsaturated fatty acid with a fifteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-10.

LPT:0000102.name: meat fatty acid C12:0 content
LPT:0000102.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C12H24O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000103.name: wing trait
LPT:0000103.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the forelimb of a bird, consisting of the humerus, radius, ulna, and metacarpus, and all associated muscle and skin.

LPT:0000104.name: wing percentage
LPT:0000104.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the forelimb of a bird, consisting of the humerus, radius, ulna, and metacarpus, and all associated muscle and skin, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000105.name: meat physiochemical trait
LPT:0000105.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to both physiological and chemical properties of meat (muscle and associated fat and connective tissue, post-exsanguination).

LPT:0000106.name: meat conductivity
LPT:0000106.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of meat to conduct electrical current.

LPT:0000107.name: meat temperature
LPT:0000107.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of hotness or coldness of meat.

LPT:0000122.name: dressing percentage
LPT:0000122.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the body of an animal following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet, expressed as a percentage of body weight at slaughter.

LPT:0000123.name: meat fatty acid cis-12-C18:1 content
LPT:0000123.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount in meat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-12.

LPT:0000124.name: meat fatty acid trans-6/9-C18:1 content
LPT:0000124.def: The proportion or amount present in meat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at either C-6 or C-9.

LPT:0000125.name: meat iron content
LPT:0000125.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of this metallic element in meat.

LPT:0000126.name: meat zinc content
LPT:0000126.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of this metallic element in meat.

LPT:0000127.name: breast weight
LPT:0000127.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the entire cut containing the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor, including skin and bone.

LPT:0000128.name: breast percentage
LPT:0000128.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the breast muscle, bone, and skin, expressed as a percentage of carcass/body weight.

LPT:0000129.name: egg aftertaste trait
LPT:0000129.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the taste persisting in the mouth after the sampled egg is no longer present.

LPT:0000130.name: fleece yield
LPT:0000130.def: amount of clean wool that remains after scouring, expressed as a percentage of greasy fleece weight.

LPT:0000131.name: coagulated milk firming rate
LPT:0000131.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the time required to obtain a fixed curd firmness.

LPT:0000132.name: meat fatty acid C13:0 content
LPT:0000132.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C13H26O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000133.name: meat fatty acid trans-15-C18:1 content
LPT:0000133.def: The proportion or amount present in meat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-15.

LPT:0000134.name: meat fatty acid trans-12-C18:1 content
LPT:0000134.def: The proportion or amount present in meat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a trans double bond at C-12.

LPT:0000135.name: meat omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid content
LPT:0000135.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount in meat of polyunsaturated fatty acids in which the first unsaturated bond is in the sixth position from the omega carbon.

LPT:0000136.name: meat fatty acid C24:0 content
LPT:0000136.def: The proportion or amount of a saturated fatty acid (C24H48O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000137.name: loin fat percentage
LPT:0000137.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut from the back of certain species, expressed as a percentage of carcass weight.

LPT:0000138.name: loin fat thickness
LPT:0000138.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance between the surfaces of the adipose tissue on the cut from the back of certain species.

LPT:0000140.name: milk vitamin B-12 content
LPT:0000140.def: The proportion or amount in milk of a cobalt-containing coordination compound produced by intestinal microorganisms and also found in soil and water.

LPT:0000143.name: meat fatty acid cis-6,9,12-C18:3 content
LPT:0000143.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of an omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid (C18H30O2), with three carbon-carbon double bonds, present in meat.

LPT:0000144.name: meat fatty acid C22:1 content
LPT:0000144.def: The proportion or amount of a monounsaturated fatty acid (C22H42O2) present in meat.

LPT:0000145.name: rib cut fat content
LPT:0000145.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of adipose tissue in the cut of beef spanning the sixth through twelfth ribs.

LPT:0000146.name: leg fat weight
LPT:0000146.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the adipose tissue in the cut(s) of meat comprising the hind limb(s).

LPT:0000147.name: milk non-fat solids content
LPT:0000147.def: The proportion or amount in milk of the components remaining after removal of water and fat (protein, lactose, minerals, vitamins).

LPT:0000148.name: dressed carcass ash content
LPT:0000148.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of minerals in the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet.

LPT:0000149.name: belly fat area
LPT:0000149.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the two-dimensional extent of the adipose tissue on the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:0000150.name: meat calpain activity
LPT:0000150.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the degree of function or response of these calcium-dependent cysteine proteases present in meat.

LPT:0000151.name: dressed carcass fat-free weight
LPT:0000151.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the body of an animal following slaughter and removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet, as well as adipose tissue.

LPT:0000153.name: meat aldehyde content
LPT:0000153.def: The proportion or amount in meat of a compound in which a carbonyl group is bonded to one hydrogen atom and to one R group.

LPT:0000154.name: belly thickness
LPT:0000154.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance between the surfaces of the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:0000155.name: meat connective tissue content

LPT:0000156.name: connective tissue protein content
LPT:0000156.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount in connective tissue of macromolecules consisting of long sequences of amino acids in peptide linkage.

LPT:0000157.name: meat collagen content

LPT:0000158.name: meat stiffening trait
LPT:0000158.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the post-mortem increase in muscle stiffness that occurs as a result of rigor mortis.

LPT:0000159.name: thigh size trait (poultry)

LPT:0000160.name: thigh percentage

LPT:0000161.name: meat fatty acid trans-16-C18:1 content

LPT:0000162.name: meat fatty acid trans-11,cis-15-C18:2 content

LPT:0010419.name: milk fermented flavor intensity

LPT:1000272.name: egg shell yellowness
LPT:1000272.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the chromatic component of egg shell color from blue to yellow.

LPT:1000408.name: belly weight
LPT:1000408.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut obtained from the underside of the pig.

LPT:1000411.name: dressed carcass length
LPT:1000411.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance from end to end of the carcass, following removal of the head; often measured between the first or second cervical vertebra or the first rib and the pelvis.

LPT:1000422.name: shoulder weight
LPT:1000422.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg.

LPT:1000426.name: trimmed wholesale product weight
LPT:1000426.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the major wholesale cuts, trimmed of fat.

LPT:1000529.name: meat androstenone flavor intensity
LPT:1000529.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of a perceived urine-like flavor in the meat or fat of some uncastrated male pigs.

LPT:1000533.name: meat skatole flavor intensity
LPT:1000533.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of a perceived manure-like flavor in the meat or fat of some uncastrated male pigs.

LPT:1000539.name: meat flavor intensity
LPT:1000539.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the meat scoring scale ranging from no flavor to intense flavor.

LPT:1000546.name: meat color redness
LPT:1000546.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the objective reflective measure of meat color along the red to green color scale; typically measured by a colorimeter.

LPT:1000547.name: meat color yellowness
LPT:1000547.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the objective reflective measure of meat color along the yellow to blue color scale; typically measured by a colorimeter.

LPT:1000548.name: meat color reflectivity
LPT:1000548.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the objective meat color variable for lightness/darkness, based on the amount of light reflected off the surface of the meat.

LPT:1000550.name: meat hematin content
LPT:1000550.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of heme in which iron is in the ferric state in meat; provides pigmentation.

LPT:1000560.name: ham external fat weight
LPT:1000560.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the fat trimmed from the surface of the ham.

LPT:1000561.name: ham muscle weight
LPT:1000561.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the ham with bone, skin, and fat removed.

LPT:1000563.name: ham weight
LPT:1000563.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the hind leg of the pig.

LPT:1000577.name: egg weight
LPT:1000577.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of an ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings.

LPT:1000587.name: pork odor intensity (lean)
LPT:1000587.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the subjective score describing the perceived intensity of the smell of cooked pork that has been trimmed of fat.

LPT:1000588.name: pork odor intensity (fat)
LPT:1000588.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the subjective score describing the perceived intensity of the smell of cooked fat removed from a cut of pork.

LPT:1000592.name: pork odor intensity
LPT:1000592.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the subjective score describing the perceived intensity of the smell of cooked pork.

LPT:1000602.name: meat chewiness trait
LPT:1000602.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the evaluation of the total number of chews required to sufficiently break up meat before swallowing.

LPT:1000603.name: meat cooking loss trait
LPT:1000603.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the decrease in the weight of a cut of meat during cooking, mostly due to moisture loss.

LPT:1000605.name: meat drip loss trait
LPT:1000605.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the fluid lost from fresh, uncooked meat due to passive exudation.

LPT:1000608.name: meat firmness
LPT:1000608.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the subjective evaluation of meat/muscle firmness following chilling of a carcass.

LPT:1000609.name: meat juiciness
LPT:1000609.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the evaluation of the amount of liquid released by a piece of meat during chewing.

LPT:1000618.name: meat tenderness
LPT:1000618.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ease with which meat is broken down during mastication or mechanical processing.

LPT:1000619.name: meat water holding capacity
LPT:1000619.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the ability of meat to retain water during cutting, heating, grinding, pressing, and storage.

LPT:1000685.name: meat pH
LPT:1000685.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative acidity or alkalinity of meat, as measured by the concentration of hydrogen ion.

LPT:1000695.name: egg albumen morphology trait
LPT:1000695.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nutritive and protective gelatinous substance surrounding the yolk of an egg.

LPT:1000696.name: egg shell morphology trait
LPT:1000696.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the outermost protective covering of an egg

LPT:1000697.name: egg yolk morphology trait
LPT:1000697.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color or pattern of the nutrient store of the egg that is surround by a vitelline membrane

LPT:1000699.name: egg yolk diameter
LPT:1000699.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the distance across the yolk when an egg is broken onto a flat surface

LPT:1000700.name: egg yolk height
LPT:1000700.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the vertical dimension at the highest point of the yolk when an egg is broken onto a flat surface

LPT:1000709.name: shoulder muscle weight
LPT:1000709.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the upper portion of the front leg, with fat and bone removed

LPT:1000714.name: dressed carcass subdivision size
LPT:1000714.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions of an anatomical structure which is a subpart of the body of an organism following removal of the head, digestive tract, internal organs, and possibly the hide and/or feet

LPT:1000719.name: ham bone weight
LPT:1000719.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the bone in the ham.

LPT:1000722.name: milk energy yield
LPT:1000722.def: The total energy content of milk; may be based on a combination of fat, protein, lactose, ash, and water content.

LPT:1000729.name: carcass temperature
LPT:1000729.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the temperature of the dead body; may be measured either before or after processing to remove specific parts

LPT:1000742.name: sarcomere length
LPT:1000742.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the length of the segment of a myofibril between two Z lines

LPT:1000744.name: neck weight
LPT:1000744.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut from the dorsal side of the pig, anterior to the third rib.

LPT:1000745.name: jowl weight
LPT:1000745.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the relative heaviness of the cut obtained from the cheek of the pig.

LPT:1000759.name: pork flavor intensity (fat)
LPT:1000759.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of the distinctive flavor of pork in fat trimmed from a cut of cooked meat

LPT:1000760.name: pork flavor intensity (lean)
LPT:1000760.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of the distinctive flavor of pork in cooked meat that has been trimmed of fat

LPT:1000765.name: beef flavor intensity
LPT:1000765.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of the distinctive flavor of beef in cooked meat

LPT:1000766.name: pork flavor intensity
LPT:1000766.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of the distinctive flavor of pork in cooked meat

LPT:1000767.name: beef odor intensity
LPT:1000767.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the subjective score describing the perceived intensity of the smell of cooked beef

LPT:1000768.name: meat androstenone odor intensity
LPT:1000768.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of a perceived urine-like odor in the meat or fat of some uncastrated male pigs

LPT:1000769.name: meat skatole odor intensity
LPT:1000769.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the intensity of a perceived manure-like odor in the meat or fat of some uncastrated male pigs

LPT:1000770.name: meat composition trait
LPT:1000770.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the qualitative or quantitative makeup of meat (muscle and associated fat and connective tissue, post-exsanguination).

LPT:1000771.name: meat mineral content
LPT:1000771.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the proportion or amount of any or all inorganic substance(s) in meat

LPT:1000772.name: egg size
LPT:1000772.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical dimensions or proportions of the ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings

part_of.name: part_of
part_of.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the length from end to end of the ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings
